Worgle answer today: what the Welsh letter pattern is hinting at

The three digraphs most likely to appear in any five-letter Worgle answer are DD, TH, and NG. Each behaves predictably once you know the rules:

  • TH appears less frequently and typically in borrowed or mutated forms. When it does show up, it's usually positioned near word boundaries.
  • NG functions like the "ng" in "sing" and almost always terminates a word. Finding NG mid-word in Welsh is rare outside compound words.
